issues.title: Turf War, Part 1: When Worlds Collide
issues.description: Secretary Stark is tasked with infiltrating Avengers Mansion to destroy a thirty year old computer program that could activate a dormant super weapon. But the Avengers don't take kindly to Iron Man sneaking around their basement!

issues.title: Turf War, Part 2: Uninvited Guests
issues.description: Iron Man has discovered Arsenal Alpha, the robot that houses the dreaded Scorched Earth protocol. Just as its programming is about to be deleted, it is inadvertently activated. Can the Avengers stop Arsenal Alpha?

issues.title: Under My Skin, Part One
issues.description: The web-slinger is confronted by an all-new menace -- one whose very presence causes his spider-sense to go bananas!

issues.title: Under My Skin, Part Two
issues.description: Will guest-star Captain America help Spider-Man turn the tide against a seductive new villain?

issues.title: Ragnarok, Part The First
issues.description: It's the beginning of the end of the world for the Gods of Asgard, and only Thor and his Avengers allies might be able to stave off that fate- but does the God of Thunder even want to? Thor- Disassembled starts here!

issues.title: Ragnarok, Part The Second
issues.description: The immortal city of Asgard suddenly seems quite mortal, as Captain America, Iron Man, and Thor discover. The God of Thunder must lead what is left of the Asgardians into their (likely) final battle!

issues.title: Chaos, Part 1
issues.description: An undead Jack of Hearts is wreaking havoc on the Avengers. Tony's off the wagon, Vision's puking up Ultron dupes, and She-Hulk is on a rampage! The death of an Avenger happens here!

issues.title: Super Patriot, Part 1
issues.description: AVENGERS DISASSEMBLED TIE-IN! Marvel Knights no more! Cap returns to the Marvel Universe proper, where he's thrown headfirst into one of the most hectic days of his career. Hydra has abducted a senator who's being prepped to run as the next president. Nick Fury enlists the aid of Captain America to bring the senator back home. Meanwhile, all is not right within the S.H.I.E.L.D. organization... who is the puppet master pulling the strings? You won't believe it when you see it!

issues.title: Jimmy's Way
issues.description: Sam Wilson has gone rogue and S.H.I.E.L.D. has given Cap just 24 hours to bring him in. Plus, a romance is brewing between Captain America and the Scarlet Witch?

issues.title: The Singularity, Part 1
issues.description: Tony Stark is on a downward spiral that may be his undoing. Disgraced and cut off from everybody he cares about, Stark thinks nothing could be worse. That is, until Iron Man goes on a murderous rampage at Stark Enterprises.

issues.title: Changes, Part One
issues.description: AVENGERS DISASSEMBLED TIE-IN! Spidey's life is thrown into turmoil as he begins to undergo a shocking transformation -- one that may well leave the web-slinger scarred forever! What is the cause of this strange mutation -- and how does it connect to the troubles plaguing the Avengers?

issues.title: Ragnarok, Part The Third
issues.description: Ragnarok appears to have come for the gods of Asgard, but will Thor be their savior, or its architect? In search of new wisdom, the Thunder God must repeat the ordeals of Odin, and the price may be too terrible for even an immortal to pay!

issues.title: Chaos, Part 2
issues.description: The Avengers must discover the identity of their hidden aggressor as a team or fail and risk being disassembled! The Avengers may never be the same again!

issues.title: Super Patriot, Part 2
issues.description: Cap and Diamondback are reunited after all these years, but their reunion is Bittersweet, as Cap is consumed with remorse over the cataclysmic events taking place in Avengers. With that on his mind, Cap isn't exactly the best company to have on a dinner date. Meanwhile, just what exactly is going on over at S.H.I.E.L.D and how is it that Nick Fury is completely unaware? Featuring an appearance by everyone's favorite Frenchman, Batroc the Leaper.

issues.title: Snapped
issues.description: The Falcon must battle his way past elite naval operatives while Cap chooses between his partner and his principles as he suffers a mysterious battle fatigue that replays his worst failures!

issues.title: Fortitude, Part 1
issues.description: The FF goes "widescreen" in a tale of epic scope and proportion as Manhattan is cut off from the rest of the world by a fleet of miles-high alien spacecraft--and that's just the beginning! With the Avengers in disarray, New York reluctantly turns to the disenfranchised Fantastic Four, the only heroes in town, to save them--but where to even start?

issues.title: The Singularity, Part 2
issues.description: Tony Stark has been called a lot of names. Alcoholic. Womanizer. Rich boy. But murderer? Has Tony Stark crossed the line? If not, will he be able to clear his name?

issues.title: Changes, Part 2
issues.description: His humanity slipping away from him, and a danger to his friends and loved ones, Spidey grapples with the amazing transformation that's taken hold of him -- while, in the depths of the world, the Queen awaits…

issues.title: Ragnarok, Part The Fourth
issues.description: Beset on all sides by treacherous foes from his past, the God of Thunder leads the tattered remnants of the forces of Asgard on a desperate quest, as the Realm Eternal burns. Beta Ray Bill takes over leadership for Thor is his almighty absence!

issues.title: Chaos, Part 3
issues.description: Marvel's preeminent super hero team has suffered serious setbacks. A mysterious enemy has sewn the seeds of mistrust and tragedy among the Avengers' ranks. In times of great need, such a this moment, all Avengers must heed the call!

issues.title: Super Patriot, Part 3
issues.description: Mr. Hyde, Hydra, The Red Skull, Batroc The Leaper... this story wouldn't be complete without an appearance by the Serpent Society, and here it is! Cap and Diamondback find themselves at the mercy of these treacherous snakes -- will they be able to escape? Will Diamondback even fight against her old teammates? What does all this have to do with those evil S.H.I.E.L.D. agents and a certain Red-Skulled villain that has been lurking in the background? Find out in September!

issues.title: Lost in Translation
issues.description: Cap struggles to come to terms with his newfound feelings for the Scarlet Witch while horrors from his past nearly consume him!

issues.title: Fortitude, Part 2
issues.description: With public opinion of the FF at an all-time low and with all of Manhattan endangered by a mysterious alien overlord, which member of the team will make a decision that will radically change the Fantastic Four for some time to come?

issues.title: The Singularity, Part 3
issues.description: Stark is still reeling from his recent traumas when his evil doppelganger shows up to challenge him to the fight of his life!

issues.title: Changes, Part 3
issues.description: Betrayed by his body and suffering the painful effects of his slow transformation from man to arachnid, Spidey must once again confront the architect of his metamorphosis - the Queen! But only Captain America holds the key to her defeat!

issues.title: Ragnarok, Part The Fifth
issues.description: What makes a god? Is it birthright, is it happenstance, or is it in the making? Thor finds out the hard way as he seeks answers on how to face the coming end of his people. Thor struggles with the knowledge of the eternal.

issues.title: Chaos, Part 4
issues.description: In the double-sized conclusion to AVENGERS DISASSEMBLED, the nefarious mystery-man (or woman?) is finally revealed. The Avengers have been to the brink and they may never make it back! Discover their fate here!

issues.title: Super Patriot, Part 4
issues.description: AVENGERS DISASSEMBLED TIE-IN! PART 4 (OF 4) After months of careful planning, the Red Skull makes his move. Captain America and his old sparring partner are in for the most grueling battle they've ever had. The Red Skull has had some help from a certain rebel faction inside S.H.I.E.L.D. and he now has strength and agility that greatly overshadow the fighting prowess of our star-spangled hero. This issue is not to be missed!

issues.title: Fourtitude, Part 3
issues.description: Galactus the World-Eater is coming to Earth to choose one of the Fantastic Four as his new herald -- but which one?

issues.title: The Singularity, Part 4
issues.description: The battle between Iron Man and his mysterious doppelganger rages on! Even if Stark makes it out of this one alive, he may not survive what happens next!

issues.title: Changes, Part 4
issues.description: At his lowest ebb, struggling to hold onto the last vestige of the humanity buried deep inside him, Spidey is lent a helping hand by one of Earth's Mightiest Heroes!

issues.title: Ragnarok, Part The Last
issues.description: It's the end of all that is, and you've got a ringside seat for the last day of the Norse Gods, as Thor struggles to break the God Cycle once and for all! You must read this, True Believer!

AVENGERS DISASSEMBLED EPILOGUE! In the wreckage of Avengers Mansion, Earth's Mightiest Heroes meet for the very last time! It's the end of an era, brought to you by Brian Bendis and an all-star cast of artists, including names like GEORGE PEREZ, STEVE EPTING, JIM CHEUNG, ERIC POWELL, DARICK ROBERTSON, MIKE OEMING, ALEX MALEEV, DAVID MACK and many more! Surely, there isn't a dry eye in the House of Ideas, True Believer.

issues.title: The Black Panther!
issues.description: The first appearance of Black Panther! On a mission in the remote wilderness of Wakanda, the Fantastic Four encounter one of Marvel’s most iconic heroes. But how are the Inhumans involved in this earthly encounter? The FF bested in battle by the Black Panther!

issues.title: The Coming of... the Falcon!
issues.description: With Captain America away, the Red Skull will play. Captain America is stranded on Exile Island with the Red Skull's murderous minions, while the red-faced devil ruins his reputation with the world. Will the Red Skull finally win?

issues.title: Hammer of Vengeance!
issues.description: The Avengers are no match against Count Nefaria. The Count is dropping buildings, taking names, and...becoming immortal?

issues.title: The Black Knight, Captain America
issues.description: The Black Knight returns to exact his revenge on the Avengers, but with the rest of the team out of town and his chest device malfunctioning, will Iron Man be able to stop him alone? Also: Captain America must save Jarvis from Bull and his gang!

issues.title: The Creature From Kosmos!!, Hunted
issues.description: Wasp's first appearance! While working for scientist Vernon Van Dyne, Hank Pym meets the young girl who will become his partner in crime fighting...and in life! Janet Van Dyne gains her sting, thanks to a super powered transformation!

issues.title: Where Stalks the Sentry!, The Vikings, Human Torch - Fugitive at Large!, The Book of Sorcery, Top Secret!, Invasion!!
issues.description: Captain Marvel (Mar-Vell) returns! Plus, see future Captain Marvel Carol Danvers in her first EVER appearance!

issues.title: Taboo! The Thing From The Murky Swamp!, The Return of the Totem!, Doomsday!, I Made The Hulk Live
issues.description: A popular adventure writer finds a giant mud creature from another planet stranded in a Brazilian swamp.

issues.title: Behold... the Vision!
issues.description: The Vision visits the Avengers Mansion, but is his mission for peace or wrongdoing? Hawkeye seeks out Black Widow to convince the ex-KGB to put her villainous past behind her.

issues.title: Case No. 1. Meet Captain America, Case No. 2, The Chess Board of Death, The Riddle of the Red Skull, Murder, Ltd., Stories From the Dark Ages
issues.description: Captain America, the Sentinel of Liberty, in World War II era action. See America's greatest hero take to the front lines alongside his sidekick Bucky!

issues.title: Sgt. Fury and His Howling Commandos, Seven Against the Nazis!, Weapons of War
issues.description: Be on the frontline or in the trenches with Nick Fury's elite squad of the Howling Commandos! The Resistance against the Nazis is now in France- will a young woman turn the tide for the Commandos? Following the earliest, legendary adventures of Nick Fury, war hero!

issues.title: Spider-Man!, The Bell-Ringer!, Man in the Mummy Case!, There Are Martians Among Us!
issues.description: The first appearance of the Amazing Spider-Man! When young Peter Parker gains remarkable abilities from a radioactive spider, he must step up and try to become a hero — while also dealing with the fantastic pressures of an everyday teenager! For with great power, there must also come great responsibility!

issues.title: Spider-Man, Spider-Man vs. The Chameleon!
issues.description:
Contains two amazing stories!

Peter Parker tries to continue a show biz career as Spider-Man, yet J. Jonah Jameson's editorials slamming him as a menace makes it hard to find work.

The criminal Chameleon breaks into a military building dressed as Spider-Man to steal missile plans. He is confronted by security officers who place the crime on Spider-Man.

issues.title: In the Clutches of...the Kingpin!
issues.description: When the Kingpin orders that J. Jonah Jameson be silenced for his negative press on Fisk's illegal activites, Spidey swings in to save the EIC. But can the Wallcrawler take the big guy in a one-on-one brawl?

issues.title: Trapped By Loki, The God of Mischief!, Filbert's Frightful Future!, Off-Limits!
issues.description: Thor, the God of Thunder, versus Loki, Thor's evil half-brother and God of Mischief! Plus, the very first appearance of Asgard!

issues.title: The Enchantress and the Executioner!, To Live Forever!, Thor's Mission to Mirmir!
issues.description: Featuring the Enchantress! After Odin realizes that he cannot deter Thor’s love for Jane Foster, he enlists the help of Loki to find an immortal mate for his son. Enter Amora, a beautiful sorceress so deadly, that the Asgardians fear her power! Will Thor be able to resist the advances of Loki’s latest plot? And will Jane Foster stick around after witnessing the Enchantress in action?

issues.title: The Day of the Destroyer!, Gather, Warriors!
issues.description: Loki and Karnilla are able to awaken Odin from his Odinsleep, who immediately rushes to Thor's aid against the Destroyer!

issues.title: The Earth Is in Danger!, Chapter One, [The Earth Is in Danger!], Chapter Two: Face-to-Face With the King of Evil!, [The Earth Is in Danger!], Chapter Three: The Wrath of a Goddess!, Stolen Love
Slave of Zarrko, The Tomorrow Man!, The Menace!, “Death” Comes to Thor!
issues.description: With his powers halved by an angry Odin, Thor is left defenseless and distraught. In an attempt to please Odin and regain his abilities, Thor accepts a dangerous mission from the 23rd century. Will Thor be able to save 20th century earth, by destroying Arthur Zarrko of the future?

issues.title: The End of the World!, The Plot!, Beyond the Third Dimension
The Thunder God and the Troll!, The Tragedy of Hogun!
issues.description: Ulik’s first appearance! When Lady Sif is captured by Geirrodur, King of the Trolls, Thor is lured into battle. But Thor isn’t expecting as worthy a combatant as Ulik, the Rock Trolls’ most powerful warrior!

issues.title: Hawkeye, The Marksman, The Watcher's Power!
issues.description: How can a man with nothing more than a bow and trick arrows go toe-to-toe with Iron Man? And is he a bona fide hero or a common thief? Ol Shell-Head encounters Hawkeye, the marksman!

issues.title: To Storm the Gates of Hell, Who Is the White Tiger?
issues.description:
Who is Jack of Hearts? Learn his incredible history here! Is White Tiger truly the killer Jack has made him out to be?

Iron Fist: The Living Weapon to storm the Walls of Hell. (page 7) Time grows short and Iron Fist may lose the Firebird's soul -- sounding the grim deathknell for the entire human race!

issues.title: Lionheart of Avalon, Part 1
issues.description: It seems like a routine mission when Captain America and Earth's Mightiest Heroes head to Great Britain to deal with the Wrecking Crew's latest scheme.

issues.title: The Brotherhood of Evil Mutants!
issues.description: The Beast again faces the perils of the Danger Room. He is eventually tripped up by a grabbing a false rope to try to swing over a water hazard. Iceman is next through the gauntlet but is too cocky at his young age and is quickly defeated. Angel humiliates him by hanging him from a wall hook. Once Iceman is rescued by Marvel Girl it is time for her test. She opens a box for Professor X which hides a cake. It has been one year since the X-men were first formed.

issues.title: Out of Hell - A Hero!
issues.description: A wrongfully charged inmate in Seagate Prison named Carl Lucas undergoes a scientific experiment. When a racist prison guard tampers with the machine, Lucas develops some supernatural side-effects! Namely, enhanced strength and bulletproof skin! Luke Cage is born.

issues.title: The Icy Fingers of Jack Frost!, I Come From Far Centaurus!
issues.description: Happy Hogan and Pepper Potts join the cast, and Jack Frost is there to give them a COLD welcome! All part of the job when you work for Iron Man!

issues.title: Trouble in Paradise
issues.description: Hot-headed Firebrand triggers a dormant volcano. What's a Golden Avenger to do when a few thousand lives are at stake?

issues.title: Doom!
issues.description: Nick Fury asks Thor's aid in investigating an alien ship heading for Earth. Thor arrives and triggers the awakening of an alien protector, Beta Ray Bill. But when Bill bests Thor and takes up his hammer, he is summoned to Asgard by Odin!

issues.title: Behold... The Living Planet!, Valhalla!
issues.description: Of all the wonders in Asgard, none can compare to the strangeness of…Ego the Living Planet! Will Hulk win over Ego to save Earth from Tana Nile? Meanwhile, Jane Foster gets a teaching offer from a dubious employer.

issues.title: The Crimson Dynamo Strikes Again!, The Seance!, The Failure!
issues.description: When Natasha met Tony: the first appearance of the Black Widow! Iron Man vs. the Crimson Dynamo with Marvel's original spider woman in the middle!

issues.title: You Can't Always Get What You Want, But If You Try Sometime You Just Might Find You Get What You Need!
issues.description: Rick Jones and the Rangers team up to save a hypnotized Hulk!

issues.title: The Mad Prince Shinto and His Suicide Battalion, Battle of the Giants, Mystery of the Sacks of Death
The Fantastic Four!
issues.description: The Fantastic Four spring to action as a team for the first time. As they learn how to control their new found powers, will it be enough to stop the fury of the Mole Man?

issues.title: The Bride of Ultron!
issues.description: Ultron has unleashed his own brand of havoc against the Avengers. See the team disassemble in the chaos. Who will fall? And who will rise from the ashes?

issues.title: The Search for Steve Rogers!
issues.description: Nick Fury has some new recruits that need some breaking-in. Can Cap and Falc train the next generation of S.H.I.E.L.D. Agents? How will the veteran super heroes pass on the torch! Find out in this awesome new issue!

issues.title: Wind From the East
issues.description: The Avengers finish up modifications on their new Avengers Complex. But when two uninvited guests crash the front gate, will the team re-consider a new security system? Featuring Rage and the irradiated anti-hero, Ramskov!

issues.title: The Coming of the Hulk
issues.description: Is he a man, monster or both? It's the Incredible Hulk, born of a gamma blast that scientist Bruce Banner was caught in.

issues.title: Venus Comes to Earth, The Ten Goddesses, Hedy's Picture Problem!, The Light-Up Bow Tie
Turbulence
issues.description: Moses Magnum has attacked a major airport at the most inopportune time for the Avengers! With the help of Triathlon, can the Earth's Mightiest win the day? Plus, things heat up between the Scarlet Witch and the newly resurrected Wonder Man!

issues.title: Beware the... Blood Brothers!
issues.description: Iron Man confronts the dual threat of the Blood Brothers! Guest-starring Drax the Destroyer!

issues.title: The Power Of The Plunderer!, A World He Never Made!
issues.description: The High Evolutionary deploys the Hulk as a weapon of mass destruction to a mysterious planet!

issues.title: Beware the Claws of the Cat!
issues.description: THE CAT STALKS AT NIGHT. In her first Marvel Universe appearance, we learn the origin of Greer Grant and her unusual role in an experiment. Enter…The Cat!

issues.title: Super-Patriot Is Here
issues.description: Over the last few issues, Captain America's faith in the American dream suffered its greatest blow— he'd been forced to take a life! Can Cap's faith be renewed after what he has just experienced? Introducing the incredible Super Patriot!

issues.title: Eelar Moves in Mysterious Ways!, Quoth the Nighthawk, "Nevermore!"
At the Mercy of My Friends!
issues.description: After being knocked unconscious by rogue SHIELD agents, Tony is thrown out of a helicarrier hangar bay and plummets toward certain doom.

issues.title: The Coming of the... Wonder Man!
issues.description: The mighty Avengers face the coming of Wonder Man! Destined to become one of the most provocative, exciting, talked-about new characters of all! Wait till you see him! Sensationally written by Stan Lee and superbly illustrated by Don Heck!

issues.title: The Serpent Crown Affair!, Part One: From the Depths
issues.description: Reed Richards links the deformities of the Hydro-Base's inhabitants to the Inhuman's Terrigen Mists!

issues.title: The Fury of... the Freak!, 30 Minutes to Live!
issues.description: When using the Enervation Intensifier device in order to heal Happy Hogan of his wounds, Iron Man accidentally transforms his friend and body guard into a horrible creature dubbed "The Freak".

issues.title: The Long Road Back
issues.description: Nomad, the Falcon, and D-Man finally track down Steve Rogers and convince him to get back into costume— but it's not the Captain America costume!

issues.title: Break-In, Free Speech, In Our Midst!
issues.description: Now that iron Man has turned renegade, the Captain has decided to bring him in — but his old friend and ally isn't coming quietly! Meanwhile, the world meets the new Captain America's partner, Battle Star! And as if that weren't enough, an all-out war is breaking out within the sinister Serpent Society!

issues.title: Serpents of the World Unite
issues.description: In this issue: The Serpent Society is founded. Consisting of Sidewinder, Black Mamba, Death Adder, Princess Python, Cotton Mouth and Bush Master the venomous team targets Captain America and his comrades! Where’s a snake charmer when you need one? Plus: An unexpected ally!

issues.title: Challenged By The Human Cobra!, The Purple Planet!, Odin Battles Ymir, King of the Ice Giants
issues.description: Thor faces off against the Human Cobra!

issues.title: Let There Be..Life!
issues.description: The baby is coming! With Sue going into labor, Reed must make a perilous journey to obtain Element X, the only thing that can keep the baby safe from the cosmic rays in Sue's body. The bad news - it can only be found in the Negative Zone! The WORSE news? It's in the hands of one of the deadliest beings in any universe - ANNIHILUS!

issues.title: A Clash Of Iron
issues.description: The Fantastic Four's battle with Ronan the Accuser rages on! But as their chances grow more and more dire, Reed must call on another scientific genius to help save the day - the invincible IRON MAN!

issues.title: The Human Torch vs. the Wizard and Paste-Pot Pete!, We Search the Stars!, Dr. Strange Master of Black Magic!
issues.description: Stan Lee and Steve Ditko introduce the Sorcerer Supreme! In his first appearance, the Doctor aids a man plagued by a recurring nightmare -- by entering the dream itself! Also your first entry into the Sanctum Sanctorum, mystical HQ of Doc Strange.

issues.title: A Little Death...
issues.description: Galactus prepares to destroy both the heroes and the villians! Now, as both sides of the engagement plan their next move, two MIA soldiers make their return!

issues.title: Dark Destiny!
issues.description: Spider-Woman’s first appearance! Jessica Drew bursts onto the scene in a deadly confrontation with Nick Fury. Her strange origin, and ties to Hydra, revealed!

issues.title: Catastrophe!
issues.description: Is the known as Paladin a hero or a villain? He's a mercenary on the trail of Purple Man, the same as Daredevil. But will he be a friend or foe to DD?

issues.title: In The Fold
issues.description: Iron Fist reflects on his past while embarking on a trip to San Francisco. What depths of madness led to Daniel Rand’s awakening in K’un-Lun? Iron Fist finds himself in an airport skirmish after a mysterious assailant makes a bold and devastating move!

issues.title: The Golden Gladiator and... the Giant!, Into the Jaws of... A.I.M.!
issues.description: The TITANIUM MAN lives again! Can Iron Man defeat a foe whose armor is superior to his own?

issues.title: The Coming of Galactus!
issues.description: "The Coming of Galactus" begins here! As the Fantastic Four struggle to understand what the Silver Surfer's appearance means, they must steel themselves for what's ahead--Galactus, the devourer of worlds!

issues.title: X-Men
issues.description: Professor X continues to train his young students that he has called them the X-men. They are mutants born with abilities that set them apart from normal humans. The X-men are Cyclops (Scott Summers), Beast (Hank McCoy), Iceman (Bobby Drake), and Angel (Warren Worthington III). The Xavier Institute for Higher Learning gains a new student Jean Grey who will be called Marvel Girl.

issues.title: ...To Wake the Mangog!
issues.description: Thor nearly has Loki in the palm of defeat, until Odin shows up! What is this new threat against Asgard Odin speaks of? And will the God of Thunder allow Loki to escape his grasp yet again? Guest-starring Karnilla the Norn Queen!

issues.title: The Return of the Frightful Four!
issues.description: The return of the Frightful Four! And witness the mystic witchcraft of a brand new character! Agatha Harkness' first appearance.

issues.title: Pawns Of The Deadly Duo!, The Domain Of The Dread Dormammu!
issues.description: The Mad Thinker and the Puppet Master have combined their efforts to outsmart the Fantastic Four!

issues.title: By Friends--Betrayed!
issues.description: The first appearance of Rogue! Ms. Marvel lies disoriented and weakened after her powers are absorbed by Rogue. Will Spider-Woman be able to restore her amnesiac friend? Just as the Avengers band together to take care of their fallen teammate, the Brotherhood of Evil Mutants attack!

issues.title: “...And Be a Villain!”
issues.description: Namor in custody of the Fantastic Four! After Doom pulls the wool over his eyes, (and the air from his lungs), Namor recounts his failed alliance to the FF. Namor plots his revenge against the Latverian overlord, but his failing health puts him in grave danger! Will Doom relinquish the cure for Namor?

issues.title: And the Wind Howls...Wendigo!
issues.description: While in Canada, Hulk is lured into an occult ritual conducted by Marie Cartier. Will Marie use Hulk’s body as the host for an evil spirit?

issues.title: A World Gone Mad!
issues.description: The Thunder God vs. Mephisto…in the haunted halls of the Sub-World! And the demon's allies are none other than Thor's most trusted friends- including the Lady Sif.

issues.title: Second Genesis
issues.description: Introducing a new team of X-Men! Several key players in the X-Universe join the team including Storm, Nightcrawler, Colossus, and Wolverine!

issues.title: To Squash a Spider!
issues.description: Mysterio has miniaturized Spider-Man and placed him in a tiny amusement park. Can Spider-Man survive this deadly Hall of Mirrors?

issues.title: The Lava Man, The Perfect Defense!, Tales of... ...Asgard! Home of the Mighty Norse Gods
issues.description: Lava Man has claimed New York City as the domain of the Lava Tribe, where he shall rule as king. That doesn't sit right with the Thunder God, so he heads to intervene!

issues.title: Terror in the Subway, Smashing the Island Invasion, Enter: The Vision, Case of the Counterfeit Paintings, Mystery of the Moon Robots, The Murder of Happy Norton, In the New York Jungle
The Stronger I Am, the Sooner I Die!, The Golden Apples!
issues.description: Behold! The Absorbing Man's first appearance! Loki bestows an enchantment upon commonplace criminal, Carl Creel.

issues.title: The Bitter Taste of Defeat!
issues.description: The Avengers are tricked into endangering the innocent by the Enchantress' illusions-- but will anyone realize the real menace to society before it's too late? Introducing the Avengers' newest foe -- Power Man!

issues.title: The Final Showdown!, Beginnings!
issues.description: It's the final showdown against Yellow Claw! ‘Nuff said!

issues.title: The Origin of the Black Marvel, The Tempest, The Discovery in the Volcano, Introducing the Terror, Garvey Lang, The Poisoned Children, The Story of Mark Todd
issues.description: Tales from the Golden Age of Marvel Comics! The Black Marvel recounts how he came into his costumed identity, centered around his mythic origin with the Blackfeet tribe of the American West!

issues.title: Vaughn-McCallum Roles of the Future, Cracked's G.I. Space Set, Updated Torture Devices for Catching the Witches of Today, Real Cracked Books, Low Calorie Everything, Camp Comic Heroland, How to Make Vehicles Safer, [Untitled], Do-It-Yourself Captions, The Flying Carpet, Camp Is Champ, E.S.P., [Untitled]
Torr, Midnight in the Wax Museum, I Am the Fantastic Dr. Droom!
issues.description: A mysterious alien warrior lands on Earth!

issues.title: [Untitled], [Untitled], [Untitled], [Untitled], Jungle Terror: A Complete Adventure Story, [Untitled]
issues.description: A collection of stories including "Origin of the Human Torch", "The Six Big Men", "Origin of the Sub-Mariner" and "Origin of Ka-Zar".

issues.title: Games Godlings Play!, The World Destroyers!, The House of Shadows!
Mad-Flight!
issues.description: Its fight or flight for the Star-Spangled Soldier, literally. Can Captain America manage to survive the slaughter in the sky?

issues.title: Power Play
issues.description: The Defenders get a little help from Luke Cage, Power Man, to go toe-to-toe with the destruction of the Wrecking Crew!

issues.title: --From Beyond This Planet Earth!
issues.description: Ronan the Accuser is dispatched to Earth by the Kree Supreme Intelligence to try the FF for the destruction of the Kree Sentry.

issues.title: Watch Out For... Tiger Shark!
issues.description: Watch out for Tiger Shark in his FIRST ever appearance!

issues.title: Let There Be... Chaos!, ...And Finally: Black Bolt!
issues.description: All Asgardians on Earth have been removed of their powers! Who is behind this sorcery? Plus, the Wrecker’s first appearance!

issues.title: Stings & Sorrows!
issues.description: Black Knight makes it a priority to study the erratic spikes in Wasp’s powers. Meanwhile, a young woman steals Hank Pym’s Yellowjacket suit and makes her own deadly modifications.

issues.title: Agent Orange, Part One
issues.description: As the orange light of avarice erupts in violence, the secret that has kept the Vega System off limits to the Green Lanterns is revealed. Hal Jordan comes face-to-face with the immensely powerful bearer of the Orange Lantern in a bizarre confrontation.

issues.title: Death Becomes Us
issues.description: Don't miss this prelude to the biggest comic event of the year! This special story recaps the key moments leading up to the start of BLACKEST NIGHT and will give readers everything they need to know about the Green Lantern universe, their ongoing War of Light, and their dark days ahead.

issues.title: Part 1
issues.description: Geoff Johns and Ivan Reis raise the dead in the most anticipated comics story of the year! Throughout the decades, death has plagued the DC Universe and taken the lives of heroes and villains alike. But to what end? As the War of Light rages on, the prophecy of the Blackest Night descends upon us, with Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps at the center of it all.

issues.title: Saint Walker, Mongul for Your Love, Tales of the Indigo Tribe
issues.description: Bear witness to Blue Lantern Saint Walker's pilgrimage of hope, Star Sapphire Carol Ferris' sacrifice for love, Green Lantern Kilowog's courageous beginnings, Red Lantern Vice's source of rage, Orange Lantern Blume's bizarre creation, and the first appearance of the mysterious Indigo, leader of the Indigo Tribe!

issues.title: Fly Away, Lost Love, Blume Godhead
issues.description: Bear witness to Blue Lantern Saint Walker's pilgrimage of hope, Star Sapphire Carol Ferris' sacrifice for love, Green Lantern Kilowog's courageous beginnings, Red Lantern Vice's source of rage, Orange Lantern Blume's bizarre creation, and the first appearance of the mysterious Indigo, leader of the Indigo Tribe!

issues.title: New Blood, Daddy's Girl
issues.description: Bear witness to Blue Lantern Saint Walker's pilgrimage of hope, Star Sapphire Carol Ferris' sacrifice for love, Green Lantern Kilowog's courageous beginnings, Red Lantern Vice's source of rage, Orange Lantern Blume's bizarre creation, and the first appearance of the mysterious Indigo, leader of the Indigo Tribe!

issues.title: Only the Good Die Young
issues.description: As Hal Jordan and Barry Allen investigate a bizarre crime in Gotham City, they come face to face with one of their oldest allies--J'onn J'onzz, the Martian Manhunter! But their old friend is not there for reunions; he's come for much more. Meanwhile, Sinestro seeks to rebuild his army and take his revenge on the being that would usurp it--Mongul!

issues.title: Through Thine Eyes
issues.description: In a lead-up to the DC Universe mega-event BLACKEST NIGHT, the former Titan Tempest returns! How will his arrival affect the team?

issues.title: Part 2
issues.description: The event of the summer continues! The dead rise across the DC Universe, bringing terror and darkness with them. What are the Black Lanterns? What do they want? Will Earth's greatest heroes survive long enough to find out--or will they join the Black Lantern Corps?

issues.title: Who Burns Who, Part One
issues.description: BLACKEST NIGHT blankets Gotham City, from writer Peter J. Tomasi (GREEN LANTERN CORPS, THE MIGHTY) and hot new talent Ardian Syaf! Deadman can't shut out the cries of the dead rising as he comes to the aid of the new Batman. It's just in time, too, as the duo face a circus of zombies including the Black Lantern Flying Graysons!

issues.title: A Sleepy Little Town
issues.description:
Black Lantern Superman has unearthed Pa Kent's grave! But that's only the beginning of the horrifying things he's about to unleash on an unsuspecting Smallville.

Kal-L is raised from the dead as a Black Lantern, and his first stop is Smalville where he kills the citizens one by one until he finally makes it to the Kent far where Superman and Superboy are visiting with Ma Kent.

As the two heroes battle the Golden Age Superman, Krypto is busy defending Martha Kent fromThe Black Lantern Lois Lane.

issues.title: When Death Comes Knocking
issues.description: Black Lantern Titans are descending together onto Titans Island! Will the Titans be prepared to fight off their deceased allies? And how can Beast Boy not lose his heart to Black Lantern Terra?

issues.title: Love Hurts
issues.description: The Black Lanterns descend on members of the Corps throughout the universe! Sinestro's assault on the Star Sapphires' homeworld of Zamaron is interrupted by another Sinestro Corps--one made up of those who died during the Sinestro Corps War! And while the War of Light flickers, deep in the darkness of space, John Stewart comes face-to-face with his deceased wife--and longtime Green Lantern--Katma Tui.

issues.title: Fade to Black!
issues.description: Just when things couldn't look any darker after the death and chaos of the Sciencell riot, Blackest Night descends on Oa! The black rings tear into the planet and the Lantern Crypt causing all the dead Corps members to rise and wreak havoc as a new and deadlier battle threatens to engulf not only the Corps, but the Universe itself!

issues.title: Part 3
issues.description: As the dead attack in full force, Green Lantern is faced with an impossible decision and the scattered remains of the Justice League suffer a terrible loss. Who can stop the Black Lanterns? Why are they rising? And how can the Spectre help?

issues.title: Who Burns Who, Part Two
issues.description: The Dark Knight continues his journey into BLACKEST NIGHT! Will the new Batman join his predecessor in the grave? Will Red Robin's reunion with his father be bitter and bloody? Can anyone escape the horror of the Black Lanterns?

issues.title: Psycho Piracy!
issues.description: It's a crisis in Smallville as Psycho Pirate attacks! Plus, Superman's dead bride returns as a Black Lantern! And she joins in on the haunting of Smallville in the second part of this terrifying 3-issue epic from writer James Robinson (SUPERMAN, STARMAN) and artist Eddy Barrows (TEEN TITANS, ACTION COMICS)!

issues.title: Bite the Hand That Feeds
issues.description: Titan-on-Titan violence! Black Lantern Hawk has his talons set for the female Hawk and Dove! Meanwhile, Red Star faces a frightful family reunion with Black Lanterns Pantha and Wildebeest, and Donna Troy faces her worst possible nightmare! Plus, Black Lantern Terra terrorizes Beast Boy!

issues.title: Feared
issues.description: For months, Mongul has wrested control of the Sinestro Corps. Now Sinestro wants a word with him. And Hal wants a word with Sinestro. But in the midst of BLACKEST NIGHT, they'll all become the hunted as the fallen Sinestro Corps members rise. What will happen? Here's a hint: Sinestro gets some serious payback.

issues.title: Heart of Darkness
issues.description: The battle continues on Oa as the honored dead of the Green Lantern Corps and the recently deceased Sciencell convicts who lost their lives in the riots have all become Black Lanterns and will not rest until the bloody hearts and minds of the Green Lanterns are literally in their hands. Kyle Rayner, Guy Gardener and John Stewart resort to their most brutal fighting yet as the Blackest Night threatens to envelop Sector Zero and send the universe reeling into chaos!

issues.title: Buried on a Sunday!
issues.description: With the death of Solomon Grundy, Cyrus has no distractions or lies to hide behind anymore. We finally learn the answer to who killed Cyrus Gold and why. But will Cyrus forgive his killer and end his curse forever? And with his past mistakes, will Hell let him go? Time runs out for Cyrus as Blackest Night hits. Is this the end of Solomon Grundy?

issues.title: Part 4
issues.description: Hold on to your power rings, because the secrets behind the Blackest Night finally stand revealed! While Earth is evacuated, Hal Jordan embarks on a brave journey to the darkest depths to uncover the truth behind the Black Lanterns! You won't believe what he uncovers!

issues.title: Who Burns Who, Conclusion
issues.description: Batman and Robin, with Deadman's assistance, try to defend Gotham City against the onslaught of Black Lanterns. But how do you defeat an enemy whose only goal is to feed off the emotions of a city and eat the hearts of all that stand in their way? Prepare for the answer from writer Peter J. Tomasi (GREEN LANTERN CORPS, THE MIGHTY) and up-and-comer Ardian Syaf!

issues.title: The Long Dark Knight
issues.description: Black Lantern Psycho-Pirate shares his pain with the citizens of Smallville! And having your face shoved through the back of your skull can create quite a bit of pain. Will any Kryptonians come to the rescue? And could the key to taking down this menace lie within the Medusa Mask? Find out in the finale of this terrifying 3-issue epic from writer James Robinson (SUPERMAN, STARMAN) and artist Eddy Barrows (TEEN TITANS, ACTION COMICS)!

issues.title: When Doves Cry
issues.description: With their backs against the wall of a battered Titans Tower, the few remaining Titans face their dead former teammates who have now become Black Lanterns! Meanwhile, one Titan discovers a secret weapon...but at what price? Don't miss the finale from writer J.T. Krul and superstar artist Ed Benes!

issues.title: To Hell and Back
issues.description: The war between the Blue Lanterns and Agent Orange implodes as the universe darkens! But a strange turn will send this epic battle in an unexpected direction when Larfleeze has something he desperately hoards taken away from him!

issues.title: Hungry Heart
issues.description: The intense and horrific battle between the Green Lantern Corps and the Black Lanterns on Oa takes a turn for the worse! The Corps realizes that the abominable, ultimate goal of the Black Lanterns is not only to feed off the Corps' emotions, but to consume and decimate the main power battery and destroy Oa forever!

issues.title: Out of the Ashes
issues.description: Writer James Robinson and artist Mark Bagley begin their run on JLA with the fall of a longtime member! Meanwhile, what's left of the team journeys to the heart of their past to decide if the team has any future at all. Of course, that means this is the best time for a savage villain from their past to attack the demoralized heroes!

issues.title: The Hunt, Part 3
issues.description: "The Hunting" continues as Halo, Katana and The Creeper attempt to capture Killer Croc and return him to Gotham City before more dead bodies surface in the Louisiana swamps. But when Man-Bat joins the fight, will he side with the monster or the monster-hunters?

issues.title: He Primed Me, Part One: Spoiler Alert, Long Live The Legion, Part Four: Star Crossed
issues.description: The return of Superboy! Superboy-Prime, that is! The grasp of BLACKEST NIGHT knows no bounds, and it is now at the doorstep of Superboy-Prime. Believe it or not, Prime has met his match. The Black Lanterns know his deepest, darkest secrets and force him to feel emotions he'd long discarded. Plus, in the Legion of Super-Heroes co-feature, Dawnstar is on the trail of the person--or people--who have been causing so much trouble for the Legion. But does she get too close to the truth? Her Legion teammate Wildfire comes to her rescue, but are the duo able to discover just who is behind this villainous plot to destroy the known universe?

issues.title: Part 5
issues.description: The moment you've hungered for finally arrives! Who controls death in the DC Universe? NEKRON--Lord of the Undead! The dark being behind the undead Black Lanterns makes his presence and purpose known, and our heroes discover they're not only fighting for their lives, but their after-lives as well. Don't miss this game-changing issue from superstar writer Geoff Johns and stellar artist Ivan Reis!

issues.title: Dead Ted, Part I
issues.description: What's blue and gold and bloody all over? This BLACKEST NIGHT tie-in issue! Booster Gold's worst fears are realized when Ted Kord comes back as a Black Lantern intent on killing his former best friend. Good thing there's another Blue Beetle around to help...but will Jaime Reyes be too late to save Booster's life?

issues.title: Dead Reckoning, The Coming of the... Clique!
issues.description:
When BLACKEST NIGHT falls, skeletons start coming out of the closets - and no one has more skeletonsin his closet than Niles Caulder, founder of the Doom Patrol. Caulder has been playing god for years, and the time for a reckoning has come. The Doom Patrol thought they knew darkness. Find out how wrong they were in this BLACKEST NIGHT tie-in issue!

Meanwhile, in the Metal Men co-feature, trendy meets grotesque when the robots battle a group of living mannequins.

issues.title: Gimme a Break!
issues.description: Agent Orange and his Orange Lanterns face off against the Black Lantern Corps, and Larfleeze finds himself wanting something he never has before: help. Meanwhile, Saint Walker comes face-to-face with the one being in the universe he has no patience for--Sinestro!

issues.title: Hungry Heart
issues.description: The Green Lanterns' epic fight to preserve Oa and the Central Power Battery from being consumed by the Black Lanterns continues. While the Corps faces the most desperate moment in its entire history, a new threat materializes that will shake them to their very souls.

issues.title: The Dead Shall Rise!, Part One: Reunion
issues.description: The BLACKEST NIGHT darkens the skies over the Justice League in this important tie-in issue! Can the team get it together in time to survive the return of the undead Dr. Light? Or will his now-shadowy evil strangle everybody where they stand?

issues.title: Matter Of Trust
issues.description: Prepare for another mind-blowing BLACKEST NIGHT tie-in. Spinning out of BLACKEST NIGHT: TITANS, the dead rise to dine on the flesh of the living! It's brother vs. undead sister when Black Lantern Terra comes to claim the still-beating hearts of Geo-Force and the rest of the Outsiders!

issues.title: The Son & the Stars, Part One
issues.description: It's an oversized BLACKEST NIGHT tie-in issue as the Black Lanterns fight the Sinestro Corps with the R.E.B.E.L.S. caught in the middle! While super-jerk Vril Dox and his team of renegades plot to stop Starro the Conqueror's rampage, they're forced to confront this major battle raging in space! Dox is in trouble, too, because these particular Black Lanterns wanted to kill him when they were alive!

issues.title: Night of the Cure, Part One
issues.description: The Blackest Night blankets the world of Superman and Batman yet again! But this time it's not what you think! Get ready for a team-up of epic proportions as Bizarro and Man-Bat face down the undead power of Black Lantern Solomon Grundy!

issues.title: A Family Affair
issues.description: It's a return of the teenage dead in this BLACKEST NIGHT tie-in issue! There's certainly no shortage of dead Teen Titans, so when the Black Lanterns come a-calling, old teammates return with a vengeance! It's a Titan's worst nightmare come true!"

issues.title: He Primed Me, Part Two: Flame War
issues.description:
Concluding the 2-part BLACKEST NIGHT tale of Superboy-Prime! The Black Lanterns have forced Prime to face his deepest and darkest fears, but what--and who--are they? And how will Superboy-Prime strike back after this devastating attack?

Plus, Conner Kent faces off with Superman's greatest enemy in an exciting co-feature by Geoff Johns and Francis Manapul. That's right: Superboy confronts Lex Luthor!

issues.title: Part 6
issues.description: The secrets of Nekron are revealed as darkness consumes the DC Universe. Everything else: TOP SECRET.

issues.title: Lost Souls
issues.description: The mystery men of yesterday are back and they seek the hearts of their new counterparts! It's Mr. Terrific vs. Mr. Terrific, Dr. Midnite vs. Dr. Midnite, Sand vs Wesley Dodds! Can the new generation of heroes survive the rise of the Black Lantern JSA? Find out from original JSA co-writer James Robinson!

The Flashes of Two Cities--Barry Allen and Wally West--battle the undead Rogues. Will the legendary speedsters be able to handle the Black Lantern Rogues' revenge? Plus, witness the resurrection of Barry's greatest enemy, the Reverse Flash in this hyper-speed miniseries event reuniting the fan-favorite FLASH creative team of Geoff Johns and Scott Kolins!

issues.title: Part One: The Living
issues.description: Fan-favorite writer Greg Rucka returns to chronicle the adventures of the Amazing Amazon in the DC Universe's darkest hour! Black Lantern Maxwell Lord has risen and he seeks revenge and retribution for his murder at the hands of Diana. Look for unexpected changes to await Wonder Woman in the course of this series as she plays a major role in the War of Light against the Blackest Night.

issues.title: Dead Ted, Part II
issues.description: Black Lantern Ted Kord is out for blood in this BLACKEST NIGHT tie-in! Blue Beetle Jamie Reyes joins forces with Booster Gold in an attempt to take down Black Lantern Ted Kord once and for all. But the battle will have consequences for the Blue and the Gold, and Booster and Beetle's lives will be changed forever!

issues.title: Back in Black, Department Store Doom!
issues.description:
The Doom Patrol battle to the death with their former teammate in this BLACKEST NIGHT tie-in! Faced with the imminent deaths of the entire population of Oolong Island and desperate for options, they abandon their roles as the World's Strongest Super Heroes and take up their new roles...as live bait.

Meanwhile, in the Metal Men co-feature, the battle between our robot friends and the living mannequins of The Clique comes to its messy conclusion.

issues.title: Semper Fi, The Birth of Nekron
issues.description: John Stewart comes face to face with his greatest failures, the planet Xanshi and his wife and fellow Green Lantern, Katma Tui. Plus, what does Fatality truly want with John?

issues.title: Red Badge of Rage
issues.description: Red rain falls! As the Black Lanterns continue their reign of terror and chaos on Oa, things go from bad to worse when a horrible loss for the Green Lantern Corps results in Guy Gardner becoming so enraged that he becomes a Red Lantern! And hell breaks loose as the Central Power Battery faces an attack from the newly arrived Black Lantern Corphans!

issues.title: The Dead Shall Rise!, Part Two: Reunion
issues.description: The JLA can't escape the BLACKEST NIGHT! Faced with the continuing threat of the Black Lanterns, Zatanna, Vixen and the rest of the team confront their pasts where fallen friends and foes retun for blood!

issues.title: Turn To Stone
issues.description: The Outsiders' loved ones are returning from the grace in this BLACKEST NIGHT tie-in, and the stirring turn of events force the team to make some difficult choices as they struggle to survive the night and stop the Black Lanterns. but the battle will be a dangerous one, and the repercussions of this issue will be felt throughout the next year!

issues.title: The Son & the Stars, Part Two
issues.description: BLACKEST NIGHT spreads across the galaxy! Super-genious Vril Dox might be the newest Sinestro Corps recruit, but Black Lanterns Harbinger and Stealth still hit the intergalactic renegade right where it hurts! And while we wish we could say that's the absolute wrost thing that happens to Dox in this issue...we can't!

issues.title: Night of the Cure, Part Two
issues.description: Black Lantern Solomon Grundy is out to destroy all monsters in this BLACKEST NIGHT tie-in! One target has already fallen. But who will be next? And what will it cost Man-Bat?

issues.title: Tortured Souls
issues.description: An unexpected BLACKEST NIGHT team-up! Ravager has sworn to kill her father Deathstroke. But what happens when they're forced to fight side-by-side against their dead friends and relatives? Will they kill each other before the Black Lanterns do?"

issues.title: Bye Bye Birdie!
issues.description: The Atom has been in the center of the BLACKEST NIGHT storm since day one. But now that storm becomes more personal than he could ever have imagined when he is hunted by not only the Black Lanterns Hawkman and Hawkgirl, but Black Lanterns Khufu and Chay-Ara! Don't miss the meltdown in another of this month's one-issue revivals of classic DC Universe titles!"

issues.title: Troubles Souls
issues.description: Black Lantern Lois Lane tracks down her undead husband, but their reunion could mean Power Girl's funeral! Don't miss this terrifying tie-in from James Robinson and Eddy Barrows!

The Flashes find themselves more tangled into Nekron's ultimate plan than they could ever have imagined. Meanwhile, it's a well-known fact that Captain Cold hates running. But when the Rogues of the past rise to claim those that still survive, he has no choice!

issues.title: Part Two: Black Lantern Wonder Woman
issues.description: Following closely the events of BLACKEST NIGHT, Diana faces her greatest challenge. Death has always walked with her, but who will guide her into the light--her mother, her sister or her lover? Don't miss this mind-blowing tie-in as Wonder Woman's life changes forever!

issues.title: Night and the City
issues.description:
As if the chaos and mayhem of Gotham City's blackout wasn't enough, Catwoman faces a dead villain that she was responsible for killing--the original Black Mask!

Will this attack against the body and soul of Selina Kyle prove to be too much for the feline femme fatale? And can she come to grips with killing (again) a possibly unkillable foe? Find out in another one-issue revival of classic DC Universe titles!

issues.title: Parallax Rebirth
issues.description:
Surrounded by friends and enemies, Hal Jordan goes into battle with a being he will never defeat--the Black Lantern Spectre! Can Saint Walker, Sinestro and the others put a stop to this bizarre Spectre rebirth?

Plus, Atrocitus reveals a tie to a power that may make him the most unbeatable of all the Lanterns!

issues.title: Red Badge of Rage, Part 2
issues.description: Witness the fury of Guy Gardner--Red Lantern! But what horrible attack on the Corps would fuel Guy's rage? And how can anyone save him from the grip of the crimson fury?

issues.title: Deadman Walking
issues.description: Spotlighting the DC Universe's magic-based characters! The Phantom Stranger, with Blue Devil at his side, battles the Black Lantern Spectre with little hope of success. Meanwhile, Black Lantern Deadman delves into the Phantom Stranger, compelled to learn the mysterious hero's true origins. But what dangers will arise if the Phantom Stranger's enigmatic past is revealed? Find out in another one-issue revival of classic DC Universe titles!

issues.title: Rest in Peace
issues.description: BLACKEST NIGHT infects the Black Adam family when Osiris returns from the dead as a Black Lantern to terrorize young Billy and Mary Batson! Now powerless after the wizard Shazam deemed them unworthy in JUSTICE LEAGUE OF AMERICA #25, can the Batsons even count on the aid of Freddy Freeman, the new Captain Marvel? Find out in another of this month's one-issue revivals of classic DC Universe titles!

issues.title: One More Question
issues.description: Greg Rucka (DETECTIVE COMICS, CHECKMATE) joins original THE QUESTION series artists Denys Cowan and Bill Sienkiewicz for the return of Vic Sage! The Black Lantern rings have made their way to earth and disturbed the grave of the original Question. Now, the faceless man returns as Black Lantern Vic Sage targets his former protegee--and current replacement--Renee Montoya. It's the Question vs. the Black Lantern Question vs. Lady Shiva in the ultimate throw-down!

issues.title: Secret Weapons
issues.description: In the aftermath of their BLACKEST NIGHT encounter, Vril Dox and his team realize they must kill Starro the Conqueror. It's a job that requires three dangerous missions led by Dox, Captain Comet and Adam Strange, who will face loss, treachery and the overwhelming might of Starro's conquering horde.

issues.title: Danse Macabre, Part 2
issues.description: John Ostrander and Gail Simone continue the epic team-up that began in SUICIDE SQUAD #67! Suicide Squad has taken capture of Deadshot, forcing him to rejoin their ranks. But the Secret Six doesn't see that happening any time soon!

issues.title: Blackest Night Starman
issues.description: James Robinson revives his beloved STARMAN series for one more issue as a Black Lantern Starman haunts Opal City. Which Starman has returned and who can stop him from wreaking havoc on the city? Well, the Shade would rather just continue his date with Hope O'Dare, but if no one else can be bothered, what choice does he have but to investigate? Just don't dare call him a Super Hero. As the rest of the DC Universe is learning, defeating Black Lanterns isn't easy--is this the final curtain call for the immortal Shade? Find out in another one-issue revival of classic DC Universe titles!

issues.title: Danse Macabre, Part 1
issues.description: Original SUICIDE SQUAD writer John Ostrander and Gail Simone resurrect The Suicide Squad as they take on BLACKEST NIGHT and the Secret Six! The Fiddler has risen from the dead, and he's targeting Deadshot and anyone who stands in his way. But someone else has targeted Deadshot – the Suicide Squad! Everything is about to hit the Wall (Amanda Waller, that is) – and this Wall hits back! Continuing this month's one-issue revival of classic DC Universe titles, this epic story carries into January's SECRET SIX #17!

issues.title: And the South Shall Rise Again
issues.description: The gun-slinging action continues! Western heroes Jonah Hex, Bat Lash, Scalphunter and Firehair rise from the dead as Black Lanterns. But will they save the west--or ruin it? Find out in another one-issue revival of classic DC Universe titles, written by DCU Executive Editor Dan DiDio!

issues.title: What Did Black Lantern Superboy Do?
issues.description: Black Lantern Superboy targets the love of his life--Wonder Girl! Can she drag the Boy of Steel back from the brink of insanity?

issues.title: Part 7
issues.description: As Nekron continues to wage war on life throughout the universe, Hal Jordan discovers the grim, true mission behind the villain's return. But the truth is so cosmically abysmal that it threatens to expose a secret that could tear the very universe asunder. You can't miss this issue of the year's biggest event!

issues.title: White Lightning
issues.description: The bloodthirsty combat in Manhattan reaches its stunning conclusion here! Earth-2 Superman returns to prove that the true legacy of the Justice Society of America is death. Can our heroes rise up to defeat their dead mentors, role models and villains? And can even the third-smartest man in the world, Mr. Terrific, devise a way to destroy them--or will Manhattan and the world perish under Nekron's might?

It's a case of the chicken-or-the-egg as Barry Allen takes on the Black Lantern Reverse-Flash and seeks answers to the very nature of Professor Zoom's impending resurrection. Plus, the Rogues witness an act so horrifying that it changes one of their own forever.

issues.title: Part Three: A Hint of Daylight
issues.description: Following closely to the events of BLACKEST NIGHT, this miniseries event concludes as the Amazonian Princess comes to terms with who she is and what her role is in the world. But will her acceptance make her more appetizing to the Black Lantern hordes--or could that emotion be their undoing?

issues.title: Lying to Myself
issues.description: Green Arrow's been transformed into a Black Lantern and now he can't help but attack his family and friends! Mentally trapped inside his own rampaging body, Ollie Queen faces his worst enemy--himself!

issues.title: Parallax Rebirth, Part Two
issues.description: The most epic battle in BLACKEST NIGHT yet comes to a shocking conclusion as Hal Jordan makes the ultimate move to take on the Black Lantern Spectre. But what price comes with the unleashing of Parallax? And what does this mean for the future of the emotional spectrum's avatars?

issues.title: Red Dawn
issues.description: The battle for the Green Lantern Battery on Oa comes to a bloody end as the new front in the War of Light emerges!

issues.title: Danse Macabre, Part 3
issues.description: It's the exciting conclusion of John Ostrander and Gail Simone's epic team-up! The Black Lanterns have both the Suicide Squad and the Secret Six up against the wall. But Amanda Waller always has a plan. That plan: Manhunter! Plus, Deadshot is forced to make the decision of his life!

issues.title: Part 8
issues.description: Earth has become the final battleground for life versus death, but how will our heroes fight back against the darkness of sentient space itself? And what does the future hold for Green Lantern, The Flash and the rest of the world's greatest heroes and villains? Find out here as the stage is set for the next epic era of DC Comics!

issues.title: Life Blood
issues.description: Sinestro siezes the White Lantern's power! If the corupt former Green Lantern can't channel the immense energy and bring down Nekron, it's lights out for the DCU! Luckily, a multi-Lantern cavalry is on it's way!

issues.title: Black Dawn
issues.description: The Green Lantern Corps descends on Earth to make their final stand against Nekron and the Black Lanterns!

issues.title: Goodbye Darkness
issues.description: As BRIGHTEST DAY begins, Guy Gardner and Kyle Rayner, along with the rest of the Green Lantern Corps, attempt to pick up the pieces from the horrific events of BLACKEST NIGHT and take a long hard look at how the Corps is run now that major revelations have come to light. Who survived (and what the Alpha Lanterns have in store for them) is only one of the many new questions that the Green Lanterns will have to answer on the difficult and dangerous road ahead.

issues.title: The Black Ring, Part One
issues.description: Look out, Metropolis – Lex Luthor is back! The dynamic new creative team of Paul Cornell and Pete Woods (SUPERMAN: LAST STAND OF NEW KRYPTON) hits the scene with an oversized issue packed with non-stop action! That's not all! Superstar artist David Finch (BRIGHTEST DAY, New Avengers) joins ACTION COMICS this issue as new cover artist!

issues.title: Sea of Fear, The Evolution of the Species, A Losing Battle, Blackest Nightmare, An Incident on Korugar
issues.description: The Book of the Black is pried open once more to reveal the untold horrors that occurred during BLACKEST NIGHT as guided by Sinestro Corps member Lyssa Drak. Be witness as swarms of Black Rings scavenge for souls within the tatters of Ragman! Cringe as Scarecrow bathes in the fear he constructs as a newly minted Sinestro Corpsman! Scream as Donna Troy transforms into a Black Lantern! Squirm as Animal Man literally feels his world--and himself--die! It's the emotional spectrum at its darkest in one special standalone issue!

issues.title: S.O.S. Green Lantern!, Secret of the Flaming Sphere!, Menace of the Runaway Missile!
issues.description: Test pilot Hal Jordan traces a downed aircraft to the Southwest desert, where he finds the dying alien being, Abin Sur, one of the Green Lantern Corps, whose ring chooses Hal to be Earth's new Green Lantern!

issues.title: Beware My Power, What Can One Man Do?, Earth's First Green Lantern!
issues.description: When Earth's second Green Lantern, Guy Gardner, is injured, Hal's ring finds a new backup GL. But John Stewart seems like a strange hero: belligerent and cocky, he isn't above making some flashy moves while fighting crime. Plus: Green Arrow responds to a race riot by deciding to run for mayor of Coast City.

issues.title: Sinestro Corps: Birth of the Black Lantern
issues.description: Why does Sinestro believe he has won? How will Hal Jordan stop his greatest enemy? What is the truth behind the prophecy of "The Blackest Night"? Where will the end results of this battle take the Green Lantern Corps? What is the bizarre fate of the Anti-Monitor? Why has Earth been assigned so many Green Lanterns? Learn all the secrets! Witness all the battles! Prepare yourself for the startling ending of the greatest epic in the history of Green Lantern!

issues.title: Death by Fire and Ice!, Earth's First Green Lantern
issues.description: Green Lantern tells the Guardians he will give up his power ring after solving the problem on Ungara, while on Earth a Qwardian searches for him and threatens his friends.

issues.title: Revenge of the Green Lanterns, Part Three
issues.description: Hal Jordan and Guy Gardner find themselves face-to-face with a group of Green Lantern P.O.W.s deep in the heart of Sector 3601. But can they all escape Cyborg Superman's disturbing plan?

issues.title: The Strange Trial of Green Lantern!, The Trail of the Missing Power Ring!
issues.description: Green Lantern is on trial for dereliction of duty - and his fellow Lanterns are the jury! But he's been framed by none other than Sinestro! Plus, can a boy who finds GL's power ring return it to our hero before he's beaten by a gang of ordinary thieves?

issues.title: Rage of the Red Lanterns, Part Two
issues.description: Barely surviving their previous attack at the hands of the Red Lanterns, Hal Jordan and the Green Lantern Corps begin to understand the gravity of their situation thanks to the help of the Blue Lanterns! Who are where do they come from? Plus, the return of Star Sapphire!

issues.title: Half a Green Lantern Is Better Than None!, This World Is Mine!
issues.description: Featuring the first appearance of Black Hand! A new villain has arrived on the scene. His name is Black Hand, and he’s devised a plot that will drain all of the energy out of Green Lantern’s ring!

issues.title: The Joker Reforms!, [Untitled], [Untitled], [Untitled], The Grade a Crimes!, The Adventures of the Branded Tree!, [Untitled], [Untitled], Here Comes Alfred!
issues.description: Don't miss the Golden Age origin of Batman's closest ally in "Here Comes Alfred"! Plus, has the Clown Prince of Crime gone good? Find out in "Joker Reforms"!

issues.title: Birth of the Atom!, Battle of the Tiny Titans!
The Infinity Syndrome!
issues.description: The Justice Society of America joins in the fight against Amazing-Man.

issues.title: Out of Time
issues.description: Frustrated by his inability to help absolutely everyone, Wally augments his own speed with Johnny Quick's speed formula. The results are more than he ever expected, and point him towards a great discovery to come.

issues.title: Chapter Two: House of Lies
issues.description: Continuing the shocking miniseries that shakes the entire DCU to its core! In the aftermath of a devastating loss, past and present members of the JLA revisit a deep dark secret of their collective past. Alliances form and trust is broken as the heroes face their darkest moment.

issues.title: The Secret of the Empty Box!, The Coldest Man on Earth!, The Race of Wheel and Keel
issues.description: The second appearance of The Flash! With the first-ever appearance, and origin, of Captain Cold, The Flash's arch-nemesis.

issues.title: Between Friend and Foe!, Where Nightmares Begin!, Whatever Happened to Sargon the Sorcerer
issues.description: Introducing the New Teen Titans in "Where Nightmares Begin!"

issues.title: Damage
issues.description: Damage is a reluctant young hero possessing devastating power beyond his wildest imaginings-a teenager capable of totaling a car with one punch, or leveling buildings for blocks around. But how he acquired these powers is a disturbing mystery. And if that's not enough, after Damage's powers first surface, Superman's old adversary, the giant cyborg Metallo, appears on the scene to test the youth's powers!

issues.title: Special Issue! All About the Justice League of America
issues.description: This special Justice League issue includes the following: a history of the JLA; a piece on various JLA writers, such as Gardner Fox, Cary Bates, Steve Englehart, Paul Levitz, and Gerry Conway; a summary of every story from Brave and the Bold to JLA 142; an article on JLA secret identities; charter and by-laws for the JLA; the JLA headquarters; features on JLA members, guests, and villains; an interview with Julius Schwartz; articles on the Superman movies; a look at the Justice League Sea World show; and more.

issues.title: Puppets of the Overlord!
issues.description: “Puppets of the Overlord.” The Overlord uses mind control to turn the Super Friends into bad guys.

issues.title: Eye Contact
issues.description: Teenager Jason Rusch has his hands full as a teenager dealing with an abusive dad and a local criminal for whom he unwisely agreed to do a job. But things are going to get a lot more complicated once he's granted the powers of Firestorm!

issues.title: Krypto's Mean Master!, The Comic Book Archer!, The Kid from Atlantis!
issues.description: Krypto searches for a new master after Superboy punishes him, with disastrous results.

issues.title: Sacrifice for Yum-Chac, The "Robot" Men, The Curse of Kulak, The Glowing Globe, Invisible-Ink Gas, The Darling Apartment, Dr. Morte, Spiritualist, The One-Man Newspaper

Monster One-Shots, Transylvanian TV, Super-Macho Coloringbook, Fright Court, Monstrous Hurry Ups!, Meet the Trashformers, Your Little Brother Really Is a Monster When..., Monster Babies Horror Tales, Monster Pets, Slippery When Wet, Fangorier, Monsters Get T-Eed Off!, Fadballs, Cracked Interviews the Grossout King, [Untitled]
Golden Age Issue
issues.description: This special Golden Age issue includes the following: "Roots of the Golden Age" by Skip Kirkland; a piece on The Freedom Fighters; an article on how the comic book affected the people and the period during the Golden age; a piece on Plastic Man by Texas Trio member Larry Herndon; "The Silver Age of Comics" by Mike Gold; fan Fred Schneider details building models of the Justice Society; a feature on Spectre continuity; "The Great Superman Movie Contest"; and more.

issues.title: Emerald Twilight, Part 1: The Past
issues.description: Hal returns to ground zero and attempts to use his Power Ring to resurrect the devastated Coast City--but his acts come at a terrible cost! Featuring the first appearance of Kyle Rayner!
Featuring the origin of the Man of Steel, Clark Kent's first day at the Daily Star newspaper, and Superman, who stops a lynching, gangsters, and an execution.

issues.title: The Mystery of the Freight Train Robberies
issues.description:
In Action Comics #1 Jerry Seigel and Joe Shuster not only launched one of the longest running comic book series of all time, they also captured the hearts of America as for the very first time they introduced the Man of Steel, the world's most iconic superhero!

Faster than a speeding bullet. More powerful than a locomotive. Able to leap tall buildings in a single bound! The Man of Steel burst into the comic book world with a bang, kicking off the golden era of superheroes, paving the way for the hundreds if not thousands of super-powered heroes who have come since.

As a distant planet takes its final breath, a scientist places his infant son into a space ship sending it to the planet Earth! Crash landing in rural Kansas, the boy is found by Jonathan and Martha Kent, where the couple take in the boy as their own. Unbeknownst to them the boy will one day grow up to be Earth's mightiest champion, Superman!

issues.title: The Doom from Dimension Aqua
issues.description: Featuring the first appearance of Mera! Aquaman and Aqualad meet Mera, former queen of a watery dimension. But when the usurpers of the throne come after her, it's up to Aquaman to protect the exiled beauty!

issues.title: Mirror Moves
issues.description: Animal Man Buddy Baker faces off against the Flash villain Mirror Master! Mirror Master attacks Buddy at his home and the whole neighborhood could face the consequences of the Animal Man's superheroic lifestyle.

issues.title: Make Way for Firestorm!
issues.description: The first appearance and origin of Firestorm! An explosion at an atomic energy plant merges Professor Martin Stein with high school jock Ronnie Raymond, resulting in the nuclear-powered hero, Firestorm!

issues.title: Introducing the Trickster
issues.description: A prelude to "Crossfire!" The original Trickster retired long ago, but there's a newer, younger Trickster in Keystone City who's got a 21st-century bag of tricks--all of them with the aim of making Flash's life miserable! The next big FLASH arc by Geoff Johns and Scott Kolins begins here!

issues.title: The Challenge of the Weather Wizard!, Meet Kid Flash!
issues.description: This issue features the first appearance and origin of the Weather Wizard.

The Amazon Princess arrives in Man's World with the wounded Steve Trevor. This story also explains the origin of Wonder Woman's secret identity of Diana Prince and features the first appearance of Wonder Woman's Invisible Jet!

issues.title: Challenge!
issues.description: The Guardians assemble all 3600 Green Lanterns on Oa to fight an attack by Krona.

issues.title: Revenge of the Green Lanterns, Part One
issues.description: Join the acclaimed BLACKEST NIGHT creative team of writer Geoff Johns and artist Ivan Reis for "Revenge of the Green Lanterns," as the Grandmaster of the Manhunters stands revealed and Hal Jordan's biggest shame as a Green Lantern is exposed!

issues.title: Alienated
issues.description: What does a strange alien autopsy have to do with Hector Hammond? And what part does it play in a dark conspiracy, years in the making? Plus, something is stirring in the waters around Coast City...

issues.title: Yellow
issues.description: As his willpower grows, Hal Jordan continues to fight the forces of the Spectre. But is the world ready for him? And what exactly does Hal Jordan's return mean to the Guardian, Ganthet? Plus, Green Arrow makes a startling discovery as a hero from the stars returns!

issues.title: Mystery of the Star Sapphire, Part 3, The Fear Within
issues.description: "Mystery of the Star Sapphire" concludes here! What is the secret nature of the sapphire, and how will it affect Hal Jordan's future? You won't believe your eyes in the final pages of this issue as the entire game changes for the Green Lantern Corps!

issues.title: Regeneration, Part One: The Deal
issues.description: When Hal Jordan calls together the Green Lantern Corps he notices that someone is missing. This sets him on a dangerous quest that will bring him face-to-face with the villainous Flicker.

issues.title: Rage of the Red Lanterns, Part Four, Origins & Omens
issues.description: The War of Light ignites as the first battle with the Red Lanterns comes to a blood-fueled conclusion. The Star Sapphires choose a familiar new member, the Guardians of the Orange Light reveal themselves and Sinestro sets out on a devious mission.

issues.title: The Battle of the Power Rings!, Green Lantern's Brother Act!
issues.description: Sinestro returns - turning Green Lantern's own power battery against him! "The Battle of the Power Rings" features five more Green Lanterns from strange, distant worlds. Plus, get to know Hal Jordan's brothers, Jack and Jim!

issues.title: Agent Orange, Part Twol Weed Killer
issues.description: The war of light explodes across the Vega System as the Green Lantern Corps battles the bizarre Orange Lantern Corps. Plus, the newest Star Sapphire begins a search for John Stewart!

issues.title: Yesterday's Sins 1 of 4: Back in the Days
Battleground: OA!
issues.description: With the Guardians held prisoner and the Green Lantern Corps in a death battle against the Qwardians, Green Lantern must break out of the Central Power Battery to get into the fight.

issues.title: Emerald Twilight, Part 2: The Present
issues.description: Needing more power to bring back the destroyed Coast City, an out-of-control Hal Jordan heads to Oa. The Guardians send the entire Green Lantern Corps to stop him. But Hal was always the best...and the rest of the GLs are about to find out why!

issues.title: The Gathering
issues.description: Veteran Green Lanterns Guy Gardner, Kyle Rayner and Kilowog lead a new generation of Lanterns into galaxy-spanning action in this 5-issue miniseries! As old foes plot the downfall of their home planet, the Green Lantern Corps must unite its ranks before shining bright justice across the cosmos!

issues.title: Squid
issues.description: Featuring the first appearance of Jason Todd and Killer Croc. The Squid arrives in Gotham City, intent on taking over its underworld and trap the Batman.

issues.title: Mystery of the Star Sapphire, Part 2, Never Alone Again
issues.description: Hal Jordan learns the truth behind the obsessive alien parasite known as the Star Sapphire. But if her thirst for him is quenched, what does that mean for the fate of Earth?

issues.title: Sinestro Corps, Prologue: The Second Rebirth, The Greatest Once, the Greatest Again
issues.description:
Hal Jordan has struggled to regain his reputation. Kyle Rayner has suffered great personal loss and reluctantly gained great power. Guy Gardner's trust in the Guardians is wavering. John Stewart's unbreakable loyalty soon will be tested. Together, these four men are the Green Lanterns of Earth; but why are so many Earthmen recruited into the Corps? What is their ultimate role in the future of the universe? And how will the secret of the rings' power threaten the Guardians and affect Hal Jordan's future?

Sinestro was called the "greatest" of the Green Lanterns; now the renegade has vowed to bring terror to the universe he once protected. The worst murderers, thieves and deviants in the universe have gathered into Sinestro's Corps for one purpose: to instill great fear. Armed with the truth behind Parallax, Sinestro's intergalactic insurgents strike hard and fast at the very heart of the Green Lantern Corps. The Sinestro Corps is about to change everything you know about the Green Lanterns. Fear them. Everyone else will.

issues.title: Mystery of the Star Sapphire, Part 1, Despotellis Spreads Fear
issues.description: The Star Sapphire has plagued Green Lantern throughout his career, but where do its origins truly lie? And why has it always sought out Hal Jordan? Discover the secret of the alien parasite as it interrupts Jordan's first date in years. Featuring luscious guest art by Daniel Acuna!

issues.title: Decent Exposure, Mogo Doesn't Socialize
issues.description: After revealing his Green Lantern identity, John Stewart battles Sonar. And in the backup tale, legendary writer Alan Moore and Tomar Re tell a tall tale to a gullible recruit. Or do they? Featuring the first appearance of Mogo, a major Green Lantern character!

issues.title: The Key That Unlocked Chaos!, Whatever Happened to Congorilla?
issues.description: Superman comes face to face with Mongul for the first time!

arcs.name: Avengers Disassembled
arcs.description: The world of the Avengers is rocked to its foundation in this cross-over event, leaving the Earth's Mightiest Heroes broken and changing their lives forever.

arcs.name: Blackest Night
arcs.description: The Blackest Night is the third part of Geoff Johns's trilogy in the Green Lantern universe.

characters.name: Black Panther
characters.description:
Black Panther is a fictional superhero appearing in American comic books published by Marvel Comics. The character was created by writer-editor Stan Lee and writer-artist Jack Kirby, first appearing in Fantastic Four #52 (cover-dated July 1966) in the Silver Age of Comic Books. Black Panther's real name is T'Challa, king and protector of the fictional African nation of Wakanda. Along with possessing enhanced abilities achieved through ancient Wakandan rituals of drinking the essence of the heart-shaped herb, T'Challa also relies on his proficiency in science, rigorous physical training, hand-to-hand combat skills, and access to wealth and advanced Wakandan technology to combat his enemies.
